body.x: Jchiglobal (CEO Oh Joo Myung) participated in CES 2024 held in Las Vegas, USA, from January 9th to 12th.

Specializing in eco-friendly materials, Jchiglobal has focused on research and development to secure expertise in the field. According to the company’s explanation, it aims to apply its patented material technology to daily goods and construction materials, achieving low cost, high performance, and eco-friendliness.

Participating in CES this year, Jchiglobal plans to showcase various eco-friendly products and technologies. The spotlight will be on the ‘Hybrid Artificial Turf,’ an essential product designed to improve air quality by removing and suppressing the generation of nitrogen oxides (NOx) and volatile organic compounds (VOCs), known to cause fine dust.

Simultaneously, the surface is treated with antimicrobial properties and heat insulation, enhancing resistance to viruses and bacteria while minimizing the risk of damage from ultraviolet rays. This enhancement in durability minimizes the potential hindrance to shock absorption over prolonged use, extending the inherent functionality and lifespan of the artificial turf.

A representative from Jchiglobal stated, “Our Hybrid Artificial Turf has proven its excellent functionality in domestic local government validation tests based on FIFA standards, leading to deliveries to major countries beyond Korea. The technological prowess of Korea’s construction materials has demonstrated remarkable competitiveness in the global market over the years, and we expect to generate delivery records in expanded areas and regions in the future.”

Furthermore, the representative mentioned, “Especially through this CES, we plan to meet buyers from the North American market and various countries, introduce our eco-friendly material technology applied to construction and landscaping materials, and seek partners for local business.”
